C arm keeps the newest body verbatim and renders older turns as digest = first 200 bytes + compaction marker (shape from quality/RESULTS.md)
finding: C0 never has k01 in context (turns carry k12, k10, k08 only), so plain transcript cannot answer: occamy emits 'k08', qwen says 'Cannot be determined'. Pointer answers only on SGLang, and costs 1.50x (SGLang) / 1.36x (vLLM) the uncached tokens per turn of the plain transcript, because each resolve adds a whole extra request over the same growing prefix.
blocker: vLLM server refuses tool calling (HTTP 400: needs --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser), so the pointer arm there ran under a text protocol and scored 0/3 - the model never emitted a FETCH at turn 4.
